proposed_widenings.name: shared non-spell on_hit_trigger family for magic items
proposed_widenings.justification: The item is neither an always-on passive grant nor a player-activated ability. Its mechanic is a weapon-attack rider that resolves from a hit event while the item is wielded.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you attack a creature with this magic weapon ...

proposed_widenings.name: crit-specific hit trigger
proposed_widenings.justification: Existing hit-trigger shapes can express a weapon hit, but not the stricter natural-20 trigger required by this item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: ... and roll a 20 on the d20 for the attack roll ...

proposed_widenings.name: target creature-type exclusion on on-hit rider
proposed_widenings.justification: The rider is suppressed against Constructs and Undead, so the trigger/effect needs a target-side creature-type exclusion gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: ... if it isn't a Construct or an Undead ...

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because forcing this into passive or activation would be misleading. The linked-temp-HP half is already representable in principle via linked damage, but the family/trigger shape is missing.
